verses.1: When Jesus saw the crowds, He went up on the mountain and sat down. His disciples came to Him,
verses.2:
and He began to teach them, saying:
 The Beatitudes
 ( Psalm 1:1–6|PSA 1:1-6 ; Luke 6:20–23|LUK 6:20-23 )
verses.3:
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, 
 for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.4:
Blessed are those who mourn, 
 for they will be comforted.
verses.5:
Blessed are the meek, 
 for they will inherit the earth. + 5:5 Or Blessed are those who exercise strength under control, for they will inherit the land ; see Psalm 37:11|PSA 37:11 .
verses.6:
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, 
 for they will be filled.
verses.7:
Blessed are the merciful, 
 for they will be shown mercy.
verses.8:
Blessed are the pure in heart, 
 for they will see God.
verses.9:
Blessed are the peacemakers, 
 for they will be called sons of God.
verses.10:
Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, 
 for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.11: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
verses.12:
Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you. 
 Salt and Light
 ( Mark 9:49–50|MRK 9:49-50 ; Luke 14:34–35|LUK 14:34-35 ; Philippians 2:12–18|PHP 2:12-18 )
verses.13: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
verses.14: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill + 5:14 Literally A city lying on a hill cannot be hidden.
verses.15: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
verses.16:
In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven. 
 The Fulfillment of the Law
verses.17: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
verses.18: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
verses.19: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.20:
For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven. 
 Anger and Reconciliation
 ( Luke 12:57–59|LUK 12:57-59 )
verses.21: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ + 5:21 Exodus 20:13|EXO 20:13 ; Deuteronomy 5:17 and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’
verses.22: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother + 5:22 BYZ and TR include without cause . will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ + 5:22 Raca is an Aramaic expression of contempt. will be subject to the Sanhedrin. + 5:22 Or the Council But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell. + 5:22 Or the hell of fire ; Greek the Gehenna of fire
verses.23: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
verses.24: leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.
verses.25: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.
verses.26:
Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny. + 5:26 Greek kodrantēn ; that is, a Roman copper coin worth about 1/64 of a denarius 
 Adultery
 ( Leviticus 18:1–30|LEV 18:1-30 )
verses.27: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’ + 5:27 Exodus 20:14|EXO 20:14 ; Deuteronomy 5:18
verses.28: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
verses.29: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell. + 5:29 Greek Gehenna ; also in verse 30
verses.30:
And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell. 
 Divorce
 ( Deuteronomy 24:1–5|DEU 24:1-5 ; Luke 16:18|LUK 16:18 )
verses.31: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’ + 5:31 Deuteronomy 24:1|DEU 24:1
verses.32:
But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. + 5:32 Or causes her to commit adultery And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery. 
 Oaths and Vows
 ( Numbers 30:1–16|NUM 30:1-16 )
verses.33: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’ + 5:33 Numbers 30:2|NUM 30:2
verses.34: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
verses.35: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
verses.36: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
verses.37:
Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one. + 5:37 Or from evil 
 Love Your Enemies
 ( Leviticus 24:17–23|LEV 24:17-23 ; Luke 6:27–36|LUK 6:27-36 )
verses.38: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’ + 5:38 Exodus 21:24|EXO 21:24 ; Leviticus 24:20; Deuteronomy 19:21
verses.39: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;
verses.40: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
verses.41: and if someone forces you to go one mile, + 5:41 Greek one milion ; that is, a Roman mile, approximately 4,855 feet or 1,480 meters go with him two miles. + 5:41 Literally go with him two.
verses.42: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
verses.43: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor’ + 5:43 Leviticus 19:18|LEV 19:18 and ‘Hate your enemy.’
verses.44: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you, + 5:44 BYZ and TR love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who spitefully accuse you and persecute you ; see Luke 6:27–28|LUK 6:27-28 .
verses.45: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
verses.46: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
verses.47: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?
verses.48: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.[’’]
